# 🧑‍🏫 General Requirements:
1. Explain your work. Provide a notebook or some handwritten derivation or set of slides explaining your process. 
1. Test your answer makes sense. Try to identify some limits in which you can have a pretty confident guess of what the answer should be, and test to make sure your calculation works in that limit. (If possible, consider encoding this test as an automatic [unit test](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/) for your code.)

# 🧑‍💻 Specific Requirements:
1. (What specific details necessary for this calculation?)

# 🧠 Metacognition:
All calculations rely on some sort of inputs, many of which might sometimes be imperfectly known. Try to be conscious of what assumptions you're making in this calculation and, where possible, try to imagine how your calculation might change if these assumptions aren't true. Be careful to not be overconfident about perfectly calculately the answer to an imperfect question!

# 🎙️ Discuss:
Use this Issue to share your method, questions about the approach, and results!
